movelist.name: Scary Face
movelist.effect: The target’s Speed is lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Take Down
movelist.effect: You may perform a Trip Maneuver against the target as a Free Action.

movelist.name: Rest
movelist.effect: The user is set to their full Hit Point value. The user is cured of any Status ailments. Then, the user falls Asleep. The user cannot make Sleep Checks at the beginning of their turn. They are cured of the Sleep at the end of their turn in 2 rounds.

movelist.name: Hone Claws
movelist.effect: The user’s Accuracy is raised by +1, and the user gains +1 Attack Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Reckless
abilities.effect: Increases the Damage Base of Moves with the Exhaust, Recoil, or Reckless Keywords by +3. Reckless Moves: Jump Kick, Hi Jump Kick, Close Combat, Draco Meteor, Hammer Arm, Leaf Storm, Outrage, Overheat, Petal Dance, Psycho Boost, Superpower, Thrash, and V-Create.

abilities.name: Sprint
abilities.trigger: The user uses the Sprint Action during Combat
abilities.effect: The user gains +2 Speed Combat Stages.

abilities.name: Tough Claws
abilities.effect: The user increases the Damage Base of all Melee Moves by +2.
